lead: A verification code input with one box per digit. Moving to the next box, pasting the whole code and stepping back with Backspace come from Base UI's OTPField.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: Theme styles handle it in `otp-field.css`; the box size comes from `--ui-height-*`.
styling.cells: The root and the container of each digit
styling.input: The input of each digit, looking like Input; the focused one gets the focus ring
